```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE)
repo <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir=TRUE)),'..'))
out <- if(is.null(params$output_dir))file.path(repo,'outputs')else params$output_dir
```

This standalone package includes the statistical recomputation and data-minimization milestones. Rebuilding requires the author-request inputs described in [data access](../data/external/README.md), alongside the Git inputs. Current AC2 summaries and tests, including EGFR expression/fusion tests, are regenerated from curated inputs. RNA-state composition and the recomputed adjusted multinomial test are checked. GSEA and upstream expression normalization/fusion calls remain frozen. Reference artwork is used only for comparison. Panel-level visual review against the current manuscript is complete; small rendering residuals are documented. A future changed render requires renewed review. See the [statistical methods](../docs/STATISTICAL_RECOMPUTATION.md), [scope](../docs/REPRODUCTION_SCOPE.md) and [validation record](../docs/VALIDATION.md).

```{r reproduce}
source(file.path(repo,'functions/R/entrypoint.R'))
if(params$rebuild)run_reproduction(repo,c('--figures','5','--output-dir',out))
stopifnot(file.exists(file.path(out,'figures/Figure_5.png')))
```

```{r figure, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(out,'figures/Figure_5.png'))
```

The original manuscript captions and displayed event-label mappings are retained in [reference/main_figure_captions.txt](../reference/main_figure_captions.txt).

The figure is available as a vector PDF in `outputs/figures/Figure_5.pdf`.

```{r statistics}
checks <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(out,'verification/statistical_verification.json'),simplifyVector=FALSE)
summary <- do.call(rbind,lapply(names(checks$checks),function(k){
 z<-checks$checks[[k]];data.frame(check=k,pass=z$pass,max_absolute_error=z$maximum_absolute_error)
}))
knitr::kable(summary,digits=10,caption='Shared numerical regression checks for this build')
```

```{r ac2_checks}
ac2 <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(out,'verification/ac2_verification.json'))
knitr::kable(ac2$tables,caption='Current AC2 table checks; frozen copies are identified explicitly')
```
